latest_news: All participating institutes/colleges/hospitals are advised to verify the seat matrix carefully to ensure the correctness of the number of seats available in each PG course at their respective institutions. Any discrepancy observed in the seat matrix must be brought to the notice of MCC before the completion of the Round 1 choice-filling schedule for PG Counselling 2026.
The Primary Assessment Board will be available until 15.10.2026, and the Appellate Board will be available until 18.10.2026.

NOTICE: Candidates are advised to refer to the Notice dated 16.09.2026 regarding the Guidelines on Assessment of Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) for Admission to Postgraduate Medical Courses, 2026. For any queries or issues related to the said guidelines, kindly contact the National Medical Commission (NMC).
